text.tspan: Death rate from famines by decade
Deaths in famines that are estimated to have killed 100,000 people or more. They are shown per 100,000

tspan.tspan: The figures are the sum of famine deaths over each ten-year period (e.g., 1990–1999 for the 1990s), divided by population. The 2020s

text.tspan: figure is provisional and includes data only up to and including 2023.
